```python
# Test basic forward addition
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, 1) == (2023, 2, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, 1), (2023, 2, 15))

# Test basic backward addition
assert add_months(2023, 2, 15, -1) == (2023, 1, 15), (add_months(2023, 2, 15, -1), (2023, 1, 15))

# Test day clamping: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap year)
assert add_months(2023, 1, 31, 1) == (2023, 2, 28), (add_months(2023, 1, 31, 1), (2023, 2, 28))

# Test day clamping: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)
assert add_months(2024, 1, 31, 1) == (2024, 2, 29), (add_months(2024, 1, 31, 1), (2024, 2, 29))

# Test day clamping: Mar 31 + 1 month = Apr 30
assert add_months(2023, 3, 31, 1) == (2023, 4, 30), (add_months(2023, 3, 31, 1), (2023, 4, 30))

# Test day clamping: May 31 + 1 month = Jun 30
assert add_months(2023, 5, 31, 1) == (2023, 6, 30), (add_months(2023, 5, 31, 1), (2023, 6, 30))

# Test day clamping: Jul 31 + 1 month = Aug 31 (no clamping needed)
assert add_months(2023, 7, 31, 1) == (2023, 8, 31), (add_months(2023, 7, 31, 1), (2023, 8, 31))

# Test day clamping: Aug 31 + 1 month = Sep 30
assert add_months(2023, 8, 31, 1) == (2023, 9, 30), (add_months(2023, 8, 31, 1), (2023, 9, 30))

# Test day clamping: Oct 31 + 1 month = Nov 30
assert add_months(2023, 10, 31, 1) == (2023, 11, 30), (add_months(2023, 10, 31, 1), (2023, 11, 30))

# Test day clamping: Dec 31 + 1 month = Jan 31 (year rollover forward)
assert add_months(2023, 12, 31, 1) == (2024, 1, 31), (add_months(2023, 12, 31, 1), (2024, 1, 31))

# Test year rollover forward: Dec 15 + 1 month = Jan 15
assert add_months(2023, 12, 15, 1) == (2024, 1, 15), (add_months(2023, 12, 15, 1), (2024, 1, 15))

# Test year rollover backward: Jan 15 - 1 month = Dec 15
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, -1) == (2022, 12, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, -1), (2022, 12, 15))

# Test year rollover backward: Jan 31 - 1 month = Dec 31
assert add_months(2023, 1, 31, -1) == (2022, 12, 31), (add_months(2023, 1, 31, -1), (2022, 12, 31))

# Test multiple months forward
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, 12) == (2024, 1, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, 12), (2024, 1, 15))

# Test multiple months backward
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, -12) == (2022, 1, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, -12), (2022, 1, 15))

# Test zero months
assert add_months(2023, 6, 15, 0) == (2023, 6, 15), (add_months(2023, 6, 15, 0), (2023, 6, 15))

# Test Feb 29 in leap year + 1 month = Mar 29
assert add_months(2024, 2, 29, 1) == (2024, 3, 29), (add_months(2024, 2, 29, 1), (2024, 3, 29))

# Test Feb 28 in non-leap year + 1 month = Mar 28
assert add_months(2023, 2, 28, 1) == (2023, 3, 28), (add_months(2023, 2, 28, 1), (2023, 3, 28))

# Test Feb 29 in leap year - 1 month = Jan 29
assert add_months(2024, 2, 29, -1) == (2024, 1, 29), (add_months(2024, 2, 29, -1), (2024, 1, 29))

# Test large negative n crossing years
assert add_months(2023, 1, 15, -13) == (2021, 12, 15), (add_months(2023, 1, 15, -13), (2021, 12, 15))

# Test large positive n crossing years
assert add_months(2023, 12, 15, 13) == (2025, 1, 15), (add_months(2023, 12, 15, 13), (2025, 1, 15))

# Test clamping when going backward: Mar 31 - 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap)
assert add_months(2023, 3, 31, -1) == (2023, 2, 28), (add_months(2023, 3, 31, -1), (2023, 2, 28))

# Test clamping when going backward: Mar 31 - 1 month = Feb 29 (leap)
assert add_months(2024, 3, 31, -1) == (2024, 2, 29), (add_months(2024, 3, 31, -1), (2024, 2, 29))

# Test clamping when going backward: May 31 - 1 month = Apr 30
assert add_months(2023, 5, 31, -1) == (2023, 4, 30), (add_months(2023, 5, 31, -1), (2023, 4, 30))

# Test clamping when going backward: Jul 31 - 1 month = Jun 30
assert add_months(2023, 7, 31, -1) == (2023, 6, 30), (add_months(2023, 7, 31, -1), (2023, 6, 30))

# Test clamping when going backward: Sep 30 - 1 month = Aug 30 (no clamping needed since 30 <= 31)
assert add_months(2023, 9, 30, -1) == (2023, 8, 30), (add_months(2023, 9, 30, -1), (2023, 8, 30))

# Test clamping when going backward: Nov 30 - 1 month = Oct 30 (no clamping needed since 30 <= 31)
assert add_months(2023, 11, 30, -1) == (2023, 10, 30), (add_months(2023, 11, 30, -1), (2023, 10, 30))

# Test day 1 stays day 1
assert add_months(2023, 1, 1, 1) == (2023, 2, 1), (add_months(2023, 1, 1, 1), (2023, 2, 1))

# Test day 1 stays day 1 going backward
assert add_months(2023, 2, 1, -1) == (2023, 1, 1), (add_months(2023, 2, 1, -1), (2023, 1, 1))

# Test multiple months with clamping: Jan 31 + 2 months = Mar 31
assert add_months(2023, 1, 31, 2) == (2023, 3, 31), (add_months(2023, 1, 31, 2), (2023, 3, 31))

# Test multiple months with clamping: Jan 31 + 3 months = Apr 30
assert add_months(2023, 1, 31, 3) == (2023, 4, 30), (add_months(2023, 1, 31, 3), (2023, 4, 30))

# Test leap year boundary: 2024 is leap, 2023 is not
assert add_months(2023, 12, 31, 2) == (2024, 2, 29), (add_months(2023, 12, 31, 2), (2024, 2, 29))

# Test non-leap year boundary: 2023 is not leap
assert add_months(2022, 12, 31, 2) == (2023, 2, 28), (add_months(2022, 12, 31, 2), (2023, 2, 28))
```
